layouts.name: IDeviceTexture_GetShaderResourceView
layouts.notes: Confirm this slot from the IDeviceTexture subobject of CDeviceTextureTarget; do not infer it from the adjacent GetTexture2D slot alone.

layouts.name: IDeviceTexture_GetTexture2D
layouts.notes:
CDeviceTextureTarget has complex inheritance (possible diamond):
  CD2DBitmap → CDeviceResourceT → CMILCOMBaseT → ...
  9+ vtable pointers: ID2DBitmapCacheSource, IPixelFormat, IBitmapUnlock,
  IDeviceResource (standalone + embedded in combined vtables for
  IDeviceTexture and IDeviceTarget).
Focus on extracting the specific slot from the IDeviceTexture subobject, not the full inheritance graph.
